description: Vitami Phase 1 complete: architecture for evidence, sources, deterministic rules, safety, questions, goals, campaigns, profiles, and traceability.
core_principles: The free initial orientation is deterministic and does not require AI.
Every scientific claim used by Vitami must point to one or more identifiable sources.
Every rule must point to the evidence claims that justify it.
Safety exclusions and stop rules are first-class data.
A supplement may exist in the library without being recommendable.
Scientific evidence and Vitami product logic are stored separately.
